steps.title: Welcome to the demo
steps.body: This short tour shows what is on the page. Use the arrow keys or the buttons to move.

steps.title: The hero
steps.body: Each step can point at any element with a CSS selector.

steps.title: Features
steps.body: The page scrolls to the target and the spotlight follows it.

steps.title: Alerts
steps.body: This button sits against the right edge; the popover stays inside the viewport.

steps.title: Not here
steps.body: A step whose target is missing is skipped without a warning when it is optional.

steps.title: Settings
steps.body: The last step. Press Done to finish; it will not start on its own again.
